authority: owner detailed docs/master integration; necessary scoped review budget and Go extra usage

review.summary: Review of the planning-guard compatibility correction found no P0/P1 defects. The guard accepts only the exact 51-task PA/PAI missing-approval negative set, delegates approved/implemented states to raw upstream, and rejects unexpected errors/warnings. One P2 robustness gap: an empty draft programme would be falsely rejected because expected_rejection demands returncode 1 even when no tasks exist. Current scoped tests pass and raw validator behavior is preserved.

findings.description: A wholly draft/review_required programme with zero registered slices yields an empty task_ids set. expected_rejection then requires returncode == 1, which the raw validator will not produce for a pass with no missing-approval errors; the guard will therefore fail CI for a valid empty draft programme instead of accepting the raw successful result.
findings.recommendation: Consider handling empty task_ids by delegating to the raw upstream result (print output and return result.returncode) or explicitly requiring at least one slice in draft_task_ids, so an empty draft programme is not misclassified as an invalid rejection.
